newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia stocks continue upward climb.
newsitem.headline: Estonia stocks continue upward climb.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse on Tuesday overcame its nervousness and most stocks moved higher on solid trade, dealers said.
The Talse increased by 1.82 percent to close on 256.36 with 60.2 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"We thought a prediction of a market fall last week was a bit early and the market is now coming around to keep prices a little higher, but generally stable," one analyst said.
Total market capitalisation reached 13.88 billion kroons compared to Friday's 13.69 billion kroons.
The most active stock was Uhispank with 22.1 million kroons traded to be 0.20 kroons higher with a close on 56.95 kroons.
Hansapank turned over 13.7 million kroons of shares to end 8.50 kroons higher on 265.00 kroons.
"This sort of sudden rise is what Hansapank's bonus issue will overcome and slow some of the more dramatic price changes," a dealer said.
Hansapank has said it wants to double its share capital with a bonus issue of one new share for every existing stock.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was 8.6 million kroons of shares with Rakvere meat plant the most traded stock.
Rakvere turned over 2.8 million kroons of shares to lose 0.10 kroons for a close on 16.15 kroons.
Tallinna kaubamaja annouced a bonus share issue worth 3.4 million kroons to improve access to the company's stock by small share holders.
Tallinna Kaubamaja's stock rose one kroon to 89.50 with a trade of 1.9 million kroons.
